claims.summary: Parity product repair: over any field of characteristic other than 2, on the cube {0,1}^n with the Boolean axioms and J the degree-D part of their closure, take 1 <= l <= n lines with protected class 1 and errors E_t = -2 x_t, and the product line with combined error E_c = prod_{t<=l}(1-2x_t) - 1. (a) If D >= l+1, every common repair of E_1..E_l (f of degree K with soundness on the window D-K, E_t f in J, f not in J) has degree >= l, attained by prod(1-x_t). (b) If D >= l + ceil(l/2), a repair of E_c has degree >= ceil(l/2), attained by prod_{i<=floor(l/2)}(1-x_{2i-1}-x_{2i}) times (1-x_l) for odd l. The lower bounds hold at every D. (c) On the pigeonhole matching domain Y (m >= l pigeons, h >= l holes, h >= l+1 for odd l for the upper bound; J the degree-D part of the closure of the Boolean, hole and functionality axioms) with diagonal errors E_t = -2 x_tt and D >= l + ceil(l/2), both the common repair and the combined-error repair have least degree ceil(l/2): upper bound prod x_{2i-1,2i} (times x_{l,l+1} for odd l), lower bound by Moebius extraction of a coefficient's non-diagonal edges B, which leaves a nonzero function of degree <= deg f - |B| on a diagonal cube of >= l - 2|B| coordinates vanishing on odd parity. The saving on the cube is in the repair's degree K only: the combined reading needs D >= l + ceil(l/2) against l + 1. Proof of (a), (b): J is the cube's vanishing ideal within degree; E_c is nonzero exactly on odd x_1+..+x_l; in the basis y = 1-2x a function vanishing there satisfies f = f y_1..y_l, so its coefficients are symmetric under complementing [l].
claims.assessment: Working proof passed by the sole fresh-context medium reviewer with corrections and a follow-up that checked part (c)'s Moebius extraction; a degree check over F_3 and F_5 for l <= 6 agrees.
claims.rationale: For these cancelling errors a product line's combined-error saving holds on the cube but not on the matching domain: on the cube the repair degree is ceil(l/2) against l, at the larger closure degree l + ceil(l/2); on the pigeonhole matching domain with diagonal errors, blocking edges give the common repair the parity bound.
claims.next_action: The proper closure: the functional pigeonhole system over F_3 with n+1 pigeons and the least n >= 2 holes with C_3 proper; at l = 2 the four conditions E_c in C_3, x_12 and x_11 not in C_3, 1 not in C_3, which need an exact F_3 closure built on a tested library.
